## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs inside MFDRO's signal scope.

## Scientific and compatibility impact

State whether formulas, defaults, seeds, configuration digests, output schemas,
or the point-in-time contract change. If none change, say so explicitly.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated an analytical invariant or contract test.
- [ ] Ran `python -m pytest --cov=mfdro --cov-report=term-missing`.
- [ ] Ran Ruff formatting and lint checks.
- [ ] Ran strict mypy and strict MkDocs builds.
- [ ] Updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` when behavior changed.
- [ ] Used only synthetic or redistributable test data.
